leaf

components · 0.2.1 · v4 C3 · aj-c-leaf

A leaf of the Reflections booklet: its kicker with the leaf's date on the same line, then the week's line or a note's big number, its picture, the note's words at the foot of the leaf, the note's foot (its entries and its thumbs) and the leaf's number. The last leaf is signed "Your journal". Its paper, edge and padding are exposed, so the booklet's desktop spread can draw two leaves on one paper.

token--aj-c-leaf-paperexposed: The leaf's ground: --paper-2 with a shade into the spine (ink 7% over 22px). The booklet's desktop spread sets none and draws one paper under both leaves.
token--aj-c-leaf-edgeexposed: The leaf's edge: 1px --rule. The spread sets 0.
token--aj-c-leaf-padexposed: The leaf's padding: --s9 --s8 --s6. The spread sets --s9 --s9 --s6.
statedefaultyes: a leaf as drawn, in its form
statehovern/a: the leaf is not pressed; its links and buttons carry their own hover
statefocus-visiblen/a: the leaf is not a control; its links and buttons carry the product's ring
stateactiven/a: the booklet turns on a tap of the leaf's outer thirds; nothing on the leaf presses
statedisabledn/a: nothing on the leaf is disabled
stateselectedn/a: the leaf in view is the booklet's (data-pos), not a selection
stateloadingn/a: drawn with the page
stateerrorn/a: a leaf has nothing that can fail
stateemptyn/a: the week so far is the week form with its words; a booklet always has a leaf
